reason: On Linux x86_64 with uv 0.12.13 and Python 3.12.3, a temporary pylock.toml containing only `default-groups = ["mygroup"]` and a package marker `"mygroup" in dependency_groups` reproduced the issue. `uv pip install --preview-features pylock --dry-run -r pylock.toml` exited 0 with “Would make no changes”; a real install also exited 0 and left mypy-extensions absent. Adding `dependency-groups = ["mygroup"]` made uv plan to install mypy-extensions 1.1.0. The existing `crates/uv/tests/pip_install/pip_install.rs::pep_751_groups` test does not cover this shape because its default group appears in both fields.
